entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A vast hedron field and ruined Skyclave floating above Tazeem on Zendikar, tied to Emrakul.

entities.name: Emeria (goddess)
entities.description: A merfolk and kor sky goddess, now understood to reflect Emrakul.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan to which the hedrons and the myth of Emeria are tied.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: An angel who knew the goddess was a fiction yet kept explorers from climbing too high, and now fights the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose visions revealed Emeria's link to Emrakul.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker whose visions revealed Emeria's link to Emrakul.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: People who held Emeria sacred and brought offerings of hedron shards.

events.summary: Iona keeps explorers from climbing too high, knowing Emeria the goddess was a fiction yet believing faith sustained her followers.
events.quote: Iona knew the truth—that the goddess Emeria was a fiction—but believed that faith in Emeria sustained her followers through the perils of Zendikar.

events.summary: With the truth revealed, Iona joins the fight to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi, including Emrakul.
events.quote: Iona has joined the fight to defend Zendikar from the Eldrazi, including Emrakul

relations.quote: floating above the continent of Tazeem on Zendikar
the angel Iona , called the Shield of Emeria
